#---- Checking missing values----
def missing_report(df):
    result = pd.DataFrame({
        "Missing_Count": df.isna().sum(),
        "Missing_Percentage": df.isna().mean() * 100
    })
    
    return result[result["Missing_Count"] > 0].sort_values(
        "Missing_Count",
        ascending=False
    )

missing_report(vendors)
missing_report(employees)
missing_report(pos)
missing_report(invoices)

###### DATA QUALITY REPORT ######

def data_quality_report(df, table_name):
    report = pd.DataFrame({
        "Table": table_name,
        "Column": df.columns,
        "Data_Type": df.dtypes.astype(str).values,
        "Missing_Count": df.isna().sum().values,
        "Missing_Percentage": (df.isna().mean() * 100).round(2).values,
        "Unique_Values": df.nunique().values,
        "Duplicate_Count": [df[col].duplicated().sum() for col in df.columns]
    })

    return report
vendors_quality = data_quality_report(
    vendors_clean,
    "Vendor_Master"
)

employees_quality = data_quality_report(
    employees_clean,
    "Employees_Approvers"
)

pos_quality = data_quality_report(
    pos_clean,
    "Purchase_Orders"
)

invoices_quality = data_quality_report(
    invoices_clean,
    "Invoices_Payments"
)
quality_report = pd.concat(
    [
        vendors_quality,
        employees_quality,
        pos_quality,
        invoices_quality
    ],
    ignore_index=True
)
quality_report

quality_issues = quality_report[
    (quality_report["Missing_Count"] > 0) |
    (quality_report["Duplicate_Count"] > 0)
]

quality_issues
summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Dataset": [
        "Vendor_Master",
        "Employees_Approvers",
        "Purchase_Orders",
        "Invoices_Payments"
    ],
    "Rows_Before_Cleaning": [
        len(vendors),
        len(employees),
        len(pos),
        len(invoices)
    ],
    "Rows_After_Cleaning": [
        len(vendors_clean),
        len(employees_clean),
        len(pos_clean),
        len(invoices_clean)
    ]
})

#------Calculating total spend by vendor------
vendor_spend = (
    invoices_clean[invoices_clean["InvoiceAmount_INR"] > 0]
    .groupby("VendorID")["InvoiceAmount_INR"]
    .sum()
    .reset_index()
)

vendor_spend = vendor_spend.sort_values(
    "InvoiceAmount_INR",
    ascending=False
)

vendor_spend.head(10)

#------Adding vendor names------
vendor_spend = vendor_spend.merge(

    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

vendor_spend.head(10)

#------Calculating each vendor's percentage of total spend------
total_spend = vendor_spend["InvoiceAmount_INR"].sum()

vendor_spend["Spend_Percentage"] = (
    vendor_spend["InvoiceAmount_INR"] / total_spend * 100
).round(2)

vendor_spend.head(10)

#------Calculating cumulative spend percentage------
vendor_spend["Cumulative_Spend_Percentage"] = (
    vendor_spend["Spend_Percentage"].cumsum()
).round(2)

vendor_spend.head(20)

#------Finding vendors responsible for approximately 80% of spend------
vendors_80_percent = vendor_spend[
    vendor_spend["Cumulative_Spend_Percentage"] <= 80
]

print(
    "Number of vendors covering up to 80% of spend:",
    len(vendors_80_percent)
)

#------Checking shared bank accounts------
shared_bank = vendors_clean[
    vendors_clean["BankAccountNo"].notna()
].groupby("BankAccountNo").agg(
    Vendor_Count=("VendorID", "nunique"),
    Vendor_IDs=("VendorID", lambda x: ", ".join(x.astype(str))),
    Vendor_Names=("VendorName", lambda x: ", ".join(x.astype(str)))
).reset_index()

shared_bank = shared_bank[
    shared_bank["Vendor_Count"] > 1
]

shared_bank
#------Creating the vendor risk table------

        "VendorID",
        "VendorName",
        "Category",

].copy()

)

vendor_risk.head(10)

#------Finding invoices with no PO------
no_po_invoices = invoices_clean[
    invoices_clean["PO_ID"].isna()
].copy()

print("Invoices without PO:", len(no_po_invoices))

    "InvoiceAmount_INR"
].sum()

print("Total value of invoices without PO: ₹", round(no_po_value, 2))

#------Checking invoices with an invalid PO------
invalid_po_invoices = invoices_clean[
    invoices_clean["Invalid_PO_Flag"] == 1
].copy()

print("Invoices with invalid PO:", len(invalid_po_invoices))

#------Combining both types------
maverick_invoices = invoices_clean[
    invoices_clean["PO_ID"].isna() |
    (invoices_clean["Invalid_PO_Flag"] == 1)
].copy()

print("Total invoices with no valid PO:", len(maverick_invoices))

#------Calculating vendor-level maverick procurement------
maverick_by_vendor = (
    maverick_invoices
    .groupby("VendorID")
    .agg(
        Maverick_Invoice_Count=("InvoiceID", "count"),
        Maverick_Spend_INR=("InvoiceAmount_INR", "sum")
    )
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values(
        "Maverick_Spend_INR",
        ascending=False
    )
)

maverick_by_vendor.head(10)

#------Adding vendor names------
maverick_by_vendor = maverick_by_vendor.merge(
    vendors_clean[
        ["VendorID", "VendorName", "Category"]
    ],
    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

maverick_by_vendor.head(10)

#------Calculating percentage of total spend------
total_positive_spend = invoices_clean[
    invoices_clean["InvoiceAmount_INR"] > 0
]["InvoiceAmount_INR"].sum()

maverick_by_vendor["Maverick_Spend_Percentage"] = (
    maverick_by_vendor["Maverick_Spend_INR"] /
    total_positive_spend * 100
).round(2)

maverick_by_vendor.head(10)

#------Creating summary------

    ],
    "Value_INR": [
        no_po_invoices["InvoiceAmount_INR"].sum(),

})

###### PAYMENT DELAY ANALYSIS ######


#------Creating a copy of the invoice data------
payment_analysis = invoices_clean.copy()

#------Calculating payment delay in days------
payment_analysis["Payment_Delay_Days"] = (
    payment_analysis["PaymentDate"]
    - payment_analysis["InvoiceDate"]
).dt.days

#------Classifying payment timing------
payment_analysis["Payment_Timing"] = payment_analysis[
    "Payment_Delay_Days"
].apply(
    lambda x:
        "Early" if x < 0
        else "On Time" if x == 0
        else "Late"
)

#------Counting invoices by payment timing------
payment_timing_summary = (
    payment_analysis["Payment_Timing"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

payment_timing_summary.columns = [
    "Payment_Timing",
    "Invoice_Count"
]

print("Payment Timing Summary:")
display(payment_timing_summary)

#------Calculating average payment delay------
average_payment_delay = (
    payment_analysis["Payment_Delay_Days"].mean()
)

print(
    "Average Payment Delay:",
    round(average_payment_delay, 2),
    "days"
)

#------Identifying late payments------
late_payments = payment_analysis[
    payment_analysis["Payment_Delay_Days"] > 0
].copy()

print(
    "Number of Late Payments:",
    len(late_payments)
)

#------Calculating value of late payments------
late_payment_value = late_payments[
    "InvoiceAmount_INR"
].sum()

print(
    "Late Payment Value: ₹",
    round(late_payment_value, 2)
)

#------Analyzing payment behavior by vendor------
vendor_payment = (
    payment_analysis
    .groupby("VendorID")
    .agg(
        Invoice_Count=("InvoiceID", "count"),
        Total_Invoice_Value=(
            "InvoiceAmount_INR",
            "sum"
        ),
        Average_Payment_Delay=(
            "Payment_Delay_Days",
            "mean"
        ),
        Late_Payments=(
            "Payment_Delay_Days",
            lambda x: (x > 0).sum()
        )
    )
    .reset_index()
)

#------Calculating percentage of late payments------
vendor_payment["Late_Payment_Percentage"] = (
    vendor_payment["Late_Payments"]
    / vendor_payment["Invoice_Count"]
    * 100
).round(2)

#------Adding vendor information------
vendor_payment = vendor_payment.merge(
    vendors_clean[
        [
            "VendorID",
            "VendorName",
            "Category"
        ]
    ],
    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

#------Sorting vendors by average payment delay------
vendor_payment = vendor_payment.sort_values(
    "Average_Payment_Delay",
    ascending=False
)

print("Vendor Payment Behavior:")
display(vendor_payment.head(10))

#------Saving payment analysis------
payment_analysis.to_csv(
    "cleaned_data/Payment_Delay_Analysis.csv",
    index=False
)

vendor_payment.to_csv(
    "cleaned_data/Vendor_Payment_Behavior.csv",
    index=False
)

payment_timing_summary.to_csv(
    "cleaned_data/Payment_Analysis_Summary.csv",
    index=False
)

print("Step 2E completed successfully.")

###### VENDOR RISK SCORING ######

#------The vendor risk table------
vendor_risk_score = vendors_clean[
    [
        "VendorID",
        "VendorName",
        "Category",
        "City",
        "Shared_Bank_Account_Flag",
        "Missing_GSTIN_Flag"
    ]
].copy()

#------Adding total vendor spend------
vendor_risk_score = vendor_risk_score.merge(
    vendor_spend[
        [
            "VendorID",
            "InvoiceAmount_INR",
            "Spend_Percentage"
        ]
    ],
    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

vendor_risk_score["InvoiceAmount_INR"] = (
    vendor_risk_score["InvoiceAmount_INR"].fillna(0)
)
vendor_risk_score = vendor_risk_score.rename(
    columns={
        "InvoiceAmount_INR": "Total_Spend_INR"
    }
)

#------Adding maverick procurement flags------
maverick_flags = (
    maverick_invoices
    .groupby("VendorID")
    .agg(
        Maverick_Invoice_Count=("InvoiceID", "count"),
        Maverick_Spend_INR=("InvoiceAmount_INR", "sum")
    )
    .reset_index()
)

vendor_risk_score = vendor_risk_score.merge(
    maverick_flags,
    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

vendor_risk_score[
    ["Maverick_Invoice_Count", "Maverick_Spend_INR"]
] = vendor_risk_score[
    ["Maverick_Invoice_Count", "Maverick_Spend_INR"]
].fillna(0)

#------Adding vendor–employee relationship flag------
relationship_flags = (
    address_matches
    .groupby("VendorID")
    .agg(
        Vendor_Employee_Address_Match=(
            "EmployeeID",
            "nunique"
        ),
        Approver_Address_Match=(
            "Approver_Address_Match_Flag",
            "max"
        )
    )
    .reset_index()
)

vendor_risk_score = vendor_risk_score.merge(
    relationship_flags,
    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

vendor_risk_score[
    [
        "Vendor_Employee_Address_Match",
        "Approver_Address_Match"
    ]
] = vendor_risk_score[
    [
        "Vendor_Employee_Address_Match",
        "Approver_Address_Match"
    ]
].fillna(0)

#------Converting relationship count into a simple flag------
vendor_risk_score["Vendor_Employee_Relationship_Flag"] = (
    vendor_risk_score["Vendor_Employee_Address_Match"] > 0
).astype(int)

#------Adding late-payment behavior------
vendor_risk_score = vendor_risk_score.merge(
    vendor_payment[
        [
            "VendorID",
            "Average_Payment_Delay",
            "Late_Payments",
            "Late_Payment_Percentage"
        ]
    ],
    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

vendor_risk_score[
    [
        "Average_Payment_Delay",
        "Late_Payments",
        "Late_Payment_Percentage"
    ]
] = vendor_risk_score[
    [
        "Average_Payment_Delay",
        "Late_Payments",
        "Late_Payment_Percentage"
    ]
].fillna(0)

#------Creating the risk points------
vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"] = 0

vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"] += (
    vendor_risk_score["Shared_Bank_Account_Flag"] * 3
)

vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"] += (
    vendor_risk_score["Missing_GSTIN_Flag"] * 1
)

vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"] += (
    (vendor_risk_score["Maverick_Invoice_Count"] > 0).astype(int) * 3
)

vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"] += (
    vendor_risk_score["Vendor_Employee_Relationship_Flag"] * 3
)

vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"] += (
    vendor_risk_score["Approver_Address_Match"] * 4
)

vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"] += (
    (vendor_risk_score["Late_Payment_Percentage"] >= 50).astype(int)
)

#------Creating risk categories------
vendor_risk_score["Risk_Category"] = pd.cut(
    vendor_risk_score["Risk_Score"],
    bins=[-1, 2, 5, 100],
    labels=["Low", "Medium", "High"]
)

#------Sorting highest-risk vendors first------
vendor_risk_score = vendor_risk_score.sort_values(
    ["Risk_Score", "Total_Spend_INR"],
    ascending=[False, False]
)

vendor_risk_score.head(20)

#------Seeing the risk distribution------
risk_distribution = (
    vendor_risk_score["Risk_Category"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

risk_distribution.columns = [
    "Risk_Category",
    "Vendor_Count"
]

risk_distribution

#------Creating a management friendly table------
risk_review_table = vendor_risk_score[
    [
        "VendorID",
        "VendorName",
        "Category",
        "City",
        "Total_Spend_INR",
        "Spend_Percentage",

        "Maverick_Spend_INR",
        "Vendor_Employee_Relationship_Flag",
        "Approver_Address_Match",
        "Late_Payment_Percentage",
        "Risk_Score",
        "Risk_Category"
    ]
].copy()

risk_review_table.head(20)

vendor_risk_score.to_csv(

)

#------Creating vendor spend analysis------
# Keep positive invoice amounts
vendor_concentration = invoices_clean[
    invoices_clean["InvoiceAmount_INR"] > 0
].copy()

#------Calculating total spend by vendor------
vendor_concentration = (
    vendor_concentration
    .groupby("VendorID")["InvoiceAmount_INR"]
    .sum()
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values("InvoiceAmount_INR", ascending=False)
)

#------Adding vendor names------
vendor_concentration = vendor_concentration.merge(
    vendors_clean[["VendorID", "VendorName", "Category"]],
    on="VendorID",
    how="left"
)

#------Calculating percentage of total spend------
total_spend = vendor_concentration["InvoiceAmount_INR"].sum()

vendor_concentration["Spend_Percentage"] = (
    vendor_concentration["InvoiceAmount_INR"]
    / total_spend * 100
).round(2)

#------Calculating cumulative percentage------
vendor_concentration["Cumulative_Spend_Percentage"] = (
    vendor_concentration["Spend_Percentage"].cumsum()
).round(2)

print(vendor_concentration.head(10))

#------Finding the Top 10 vendors------
top_10_vendors = vendor_concentration.head(10)

        "InvoiceAmount_INR",

    ]
])

#------Calculating Top 10 concentration------

print(

)

ax1 = plt.axes([0.05, 0.87, 0.17, 0.08])
ax1.axis("off")

ax1.text(
    0.5, 0.5,
    f"₹{total_spend/10000000:.2f} Cr\nTotal Spend",
    ha="center",
    va="center",
    fontsize=16,
    fontweight="bold"
)


# KPI 2


ax2 = plt.axes([0.25, 0.87, 0.17, 0.08])
ax2.axis("off")

ax2.text(
    0.5, 0.5,
    f"{total_invoices:,}\nInvoices",
    ha="center",
    va="center",
    fontsize=16,
    fontweight="bold"
)


# KPI 3


ax3 = plt.axes([0.45, 0.87, 0.17, 0.08])
ax3.axis("off")

ax3.text(
    0.5, 0.5,
    f"{total_vendors:,}\nVendors",
    ha="center",
    va="center",
    fontsize=16,
    fontweight="bold"
)


# KPI 4


ax4 = plt.axes([0.65, 0.87, 0.17, 0.08])
ax4.axis("off")

ax4.text(
    0.5, 0.5,
    f"{no_po_count:,}\nNo-PO Invoices",
    ha="center",
    va="center",
    fontsize=16,
    fontweight="bold"
)


# KPI 5


ax5 = plt.axes([0.82, 0.87, 0.13, 0.08])
ax5.axis("off")

ax5.text(
    0.5, 0.5,
    f"{high_risk_count:,}\nHigh-Risk Vendors",
    ha="center",
    va="center",
    fontsize=15,
    fontweight="bold"
)


# Monthly Spend


ax6 = fig.add_axes([0.07, 0.55, 0.40, 0.23])

ax6.plot(
    monthly_spend["Month"],
    monthly_spend["InvoiceAmount_INR"],
    marker="o"
)

ax6.set_title("Monthly Procurement Spend")
ax6.set_xlabel("Month")
ax6.set_ylabel("Spend (INR)")
ax6.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)


# Top Vendors


ax7 = fig.add_axes([0.55, 0.55, 0.38, 0.23])

ax7.bar(
    top_10_vendors["VendorName"],
    top_10_vendors["Spend_Percentage"]
)

ax7.set_title("Top 10 Vendors — Share of Spend")
ax7.set_ylabel("Spend Share (%)")
ax7.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=60)




# Risk Distribution


ax9 = fig.add_axes([0.55, 0.20, 0.38, 0.23])

ax9.bar(
    risk_distribution["Risk_Category"],
    risk_distribution["Vendor_Count"]
)

ax9.set_title("Vendor Risk Distribution")
ax9.set_ylabel("Vendor Count")


# Dashboard title


fig.suptitle(
    "Nova Precision Manufacturing — Procurement Analytics Dashboard",
    fontsize=22,
    fontweight="bold"
)

plt.savefig(
    "outputs/procurement_analytics_dashboard.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

import shutil

#------Folder containing CSV files------
source_folder = "cleaned_data"

#------Creating a ZIP file containing the entire cleaned_data folder------
shutil.make_archive(
    "Nova_Procurement_Cleaned_Data",
    "zip",
    source_folder
)

print("ZIP file created successfully!")
